name: gh_pr_view
description: View a GitHub pull request (read-only). Returns title, body, state, author, and other metadata.

repo.description: Optional OWNER/REPO. Defaults to the repository of the current directory.

name: gh_issue_view
description: View a GitHub issue (read-only). Returns title, body, state, author, and other metadata.

repo.description: Optional OWNER/REPO. Defaults to the repository of the current directory.

name: list_directory
description: List the files and folders inside a local directory.

path.description: Absolute or relative path. Use . for the current directory.

name: print_file
description: Print the contents of a local file.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Creates parent directories if needed.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file.

content.description: The full content to write to the file.

name: patch_file
description: Replace a unique string in an existing file. The old_string must appear exactly once.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file.

old_string.description: The exact text to find. Must appear exactly once in the file.

new_string.description: The text to replace old_string with.
